demand: Static deployment, service-discovery, endpoint, and Terraform-output impact.
identitySummary: Environment, service scope, identity kind, service/port, or output name.
compatibilitySummary: Removal is breaking; additions are compatible; deployment activation remains explicit.
evidenceRendering: Exact static paths, ranges, immutable hashes, versions, coverage, and remedy.
limitations: Helm supports only declared scalar .Values substitutions; templates are never executed.
Terraform state, plans, variable values, modules, provider APIs, and commands are excluded.
Unknown templates, dynamic names, and runtime controller mutations remain partial coverage.
